name: In Full Bloom
source:
Legends tell of a remote mountain village that holds a mysterious panacea– the remedy for all sickness. Drawn by curiosity and ambition, you arrive at Petalridge at the peak of spring.

The price? Breathe life back into the town, and the panacea will be yours.

[From [url=https://saiyohara.itch.io/in-full-bloom]Itch.io[/url]]
